model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, показваща сравнение на точността (%) между шест различни модели – DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, SRPO и PPO – върху три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представя категориите, а вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62 с интервали от 2%. Категориите са подредени в азбучен ред, като всяка категория съдържа група от шест стълба, всяка с различен визуален патерн, съответстващ на модела, както е посочено в легендата в горния десен ъгъл. Стълбовете във всяка група са подредени в следния ред: DAPO+Self-reflection (син с хоризонтални линии), GRPO (оранжев с дигонални линии), DAPO (сив с вертикални линии), PPO+Self-reflection (зелен с кръстосани линии), SRPO (оранжев със засечки) и PPO (зелен със засечки). Всички стълбове са визуално различими чрез уникални патерни и цветове, без допълнителни визуални акценти като засенчване или удебеляване.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain, with the three categories listed from left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at intervals of 2%. Each domain has a group of five bars, each representing one of the models, distinguished by a unique color and pattern as indicated in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, the bars are ordered from left to right as DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), and SRPO (light green with diagonal stripes). In the MMLU domain, the order is the same. In the Physics domain, the order is also the same. The height of each bar corresponds to its accuracy value. For Mathverse, the accuracy values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 56%, GRPO at 54%, DAPO at 53%, PPO+Self-reflection at 55%, and SRPO at 54%. For MMLU, the values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 57%, GRPO at 56%, DAPO at 56%, PPO+Self-reflection at 56%, and SRPO at 54%. For Physics, the values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 61%, GRPO at 58%, DAPO at 57%, PPO+Self-reflection at 59%, and SRPO at 61%. The chart shows that SRPO achieves the highest accuracy in the Physics domain, while DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy in the MMLU domain. The bar for DAPO+Self-reflection is the tallest in the Physics domain, and the bar for SRPO is the tallest in the Mathverse and Physics domains. The bars are arranged in a clustered format, with each cluster corresponding to a domain and containing five bars for the five models. The chart does not appear to be sorted by any specific order, and there are no visual emphases such as shadows or outlines on any of the bars.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO—across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 2% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. Each domain contains a group of five bars, each corresponding to one model, with distinct patterns and colors as indicated by the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (diagonal orange), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes). For the Mathverse domain, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.2%, followed by SRPO at about 55.8%, GRPO at 53.5%, DAPO at 53.2%, and PPO at 53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again leads with around 57.0%, followed by SRPO at approximately 57.2%, GRPO at 55.7%, DAPO at 55.9%, and PPO at 54.6%. In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches the highest accuracy at about 60.8%, followed by SRPO at approximately 60.5%, GRPO at 58.2%, DAPO at 57.5%, and PPO at 59.2%. The chart clearly shows that DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO consistently achieve the highest accuracy across all domains, with DAPO+Self-reflection leading in two of the three domains.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit in Prozent für verschiedene Modelle, die auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen – Mathverse, MMLU und Physics – getestet wurden. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die drei Datensätze, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit einer Skala in Einheiten von 1. Für jeden Datensatz sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einem Modell entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), GRPO (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (blau mit diagonalen Strichen), PPO+Self-reflection (dunkelgrün) und SRPO (orange). Die Balken sind in jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet, wobei die Farben und Muster durch die Legende oben rechts identifiziert werden. Die Balkenlängen variieren je nach Modell und Datensatz; beispielsweise erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection auf dem Datensatz Physics einen Wert von etwa 61 %, während DAPO auf Mathverse bei etwa 53 % liegt. Die Balken innerhalb jeder Gruppe sind nicht nach Höhe sortiert, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck.
